N-acetylcylcysteine and A.A.H.C. are mucolytic agents in vitro and in vivo and 4-molar aqueous urea is not.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the stress relaxation method, using a modified chemical balance, is a simple, accurate, and reproducible means of studying mucolytic agents.

rheological studies are a useful adjunct in assessing the efficacy of a mucolytic agent in vitro and in vivo, and may provide a useful tool in assessing the activity of other drugs on sputum.
